description: Use this when someone asks "is my property tax too high", "is my home over-assessed", "what is my home assessed at", or wants to know if they can appeal the property tax assessment on a specific US address. Works for any US address. Takes a full street address, confirms the property and county, and returns the assessed value with its tax year and source link (read from the official county record where we connect to it directly, otherwise found by a live search of county and public record pages, and it says which), an estimated annual tax bill with the rate used, what a 10% lower value would save, the appeal deadline with days left, who hears the appeal and how to file, and a result card with a button to the free Grove Hopper report (comparable sales and assessments, strongest appeal angle, unclaimed exemptions). Can take up to about 25 seconds for addresses that need the live search. Do not use for general questions with no address (use answer_property_tax_question) or for non-US properties. Read-only; nothing is filed or submitted.

address.description: Full US street address with city and state, for example "745 N 24th St, Philadelphia, PA 19130".
